reviews.title: Amazing Noise Canceling- still in shock how well they did for my very loud home
reviews.comment: I am not a person who writes reviews but this product deserves it. I purchased "EPOS Impact 1060T ANC Adaptive Noise-Cancelling Wireless Headset for PC with Active Noise Cancellation, AI™ Mic, Super Wideband Audio, Bluetooth, Wireless Charging, Microsoft Teams Certified" I work from home doing sales. When doing sales, any background noise can potentially lose a sale. My previous headset stopped working. Since I wasn't 100% happy with my previous headset, I decided to do some quick research to see if I wanted to try a new brand this time. I after finding a few videos decided to change and purchased this headset. I honestly couldn't be HAPPIER. Once the software installed (very quick) I decided to test them out. I pushed record and asked my husband to pretend he was banging on the door and yelling for me. He stepped out of the office and did as I ask. To my amazement, I listened to the recording and couldn't hear my husband speaking at all even though he was 2 feet away and everything thay happened there after. Next we my son started practicing his trombone in the living room while I was finishing up so I decided to test it again. To my SHOCK, the recording showed that the headset not only canceled the trombone (about 9 feet away) but also canceled my toddler yelling asking for a turn all on the trombone and my husband standing next to me. After all this I did want to really push the limits and asked my son to step into my office and play his trombone as loud as he could. I will say the noise canceling technology did really well. The recording showed it did pick up the sound but sounded like phone static. If you need a headset to pretty much eliminate background noise I HIGHLY recommend "EPOS Impact 1060T ANC Adaptive Noise-Cancelling Wireless Headset for PC with Active Noise Cancellation, AI™ Mic, Super Wideband Audio, Bluetooth, Wireless Charging, Microsoft Teams Certified"
reviews.author: Jennifer Johnson

reviews.title: Mic canceling all background noise
reviews.comment: Unbelievably good noise canceling mic. I have been in airports with loud speakers going and person on the other end has no clue. Mute function by flipping the mic up has glitched twice and not unmuted me to talk in a meeting but if you simply cycle it up and down again it turns mic on.  But hey I’d rather that then it randomly coming on.
reviews.author: logan

reviews.title: Good quality. Average ANC
reviews.comment: I’ve been using this headset for about two months now. The sound quality is great. It’s a bit tighter on the head then say the Jabra evolves 65 but that’s OK because I like how it blocks outside sounds better.  Only complaint is the ANC feature is barely noticeable which is the main feature I was looking for in a new headset.
reviews.author: LJsayswhatsup

reviews.title: Randomly Restarts Itself - EPOS says it's a "known issue"
reviews.comment: I'd give the 0 stars if I could. The headset randomly will restart itself and go through a long startup and reconnect process at the start of calls. When it works, it is a solid headset, but the issue is it's unreliable. I went through EPOS support for troubleshooting and they provided a beta firmware which took 1 hour to complete that supposedly fixes that "known issue" and it made it worse. They sent a new headset to me. A couple of weeks later and now the new headset connects and reports its working fine, but no audio plays no matter what device it is connected to. EPOS says they have a no refund policy and that they only replace the headset... Luckily Amazon is the saving grace here and is allowing me to return and get a refund for the headset.
reviews.author: Azulier

reviews.comment: Great mic quality, however did little for wind isolation and dog barking.
